summary: Apollomics Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing the resignations of two directors (Mr. Yi-An Chu and Dr. Chen-Huan (Jack) Jan) effective July 20, 2026, with no disagreements cited. The board appointed Mr. Hung-Hsien Yen as a Class I director to fill the vacancy, also serving on the Audit Committee and as Chairman of the Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee. Mr. Yen receives a pro-rated annual equity award of 500 RSUs, a $24,000 annual retainer, and committee fees. The board now has six members, including four independents. This is a routine board change, not a forced departure, so it is not a special-situation management change event. What to watch: no market-moving impact expected.
